reviews.text:
I have used Crystal Pool for several years now and have zero complaints!  The staff's expansive knowledge of pool systems, chemical management, and filtration system replacements and repairs is unmatched in the Mid-Cities.  James and his staff are friendly and vastly knowledgeable.  Over the years James, his family, staff, and I have become friends and I highly recommend his services to anyone looking for pool management, or unhappy with their current pool services.
Chris Dixon

James has been taking care of our pool since we moved in 8 months ago. He is very knowledgeable and thorough with his service. He is able to answer all our questions and our pool has been in great condition under his care. Highly recommend his services.

We have used Crystal Pool Management for several years. They are knowledgeable, dependable and reasonable. We’ve referred them to several of our friends and they value this company’s work ethic also. Mitch and Carol
James and the Crystal Pool Management team take excellent care of our pool.  They even do repairs and installations and respond quickly.  I highly recommend them!

data.address: 7925 Meadow View Tr, Fort Worth, TX 76120

reviews.text:
I have used Crystal Pool for several years now and have zero complaints!  The staff's expansive knowledge of pool systems, chemical management, and filtration system replacements and repairs is unmatched in the Mid-Cities.  James and his staff are friendly and vastly knowledgeable.  Over the years James, his family, staff, and I have become friends and I highly recommend his services to anyone looking for pool management, or unhappy with their current pool services.
Chris Dixon
reviews.author: chris dixon

reviews.text: James has been taking care of our pool since we moved in 8 months ago. He is very knowledgeable and thorough with his service. He is able to answer all our questions and our pool has been in great condition under his care. Highly recommend his services.
reviews.author: Corina Bocsardi

reviews.text: We have used Crystal Pool Management for several years. They are knowledgeable, dependable and reasonable. We’ve referred them to several of our friends and they value this company’s work ethic also. Mitch and Carol
reviews.author: Carol Factor

reviews.text: James and the Crystal Pool Management team take excellent care of our pool.  They even do repairs and installations and respond quickly.  I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Anne Dollar

data.summary: Reviews show strong signs of inauthenticity. The same four 5-star reviews appear verbatim on both the company's local and HQ Google listings, all posted approximately 5 years ago. The extremely low review count, lack of recent activity, and absence on other platforms suggest the reviews may have been fabricated to create an initial positive impression.
fake_signals: Identical reviews posted on two different Google profiles
All positive reviews posted around the same time (5 years ago)
Very low review count for an established company
No negative or detailed critical reviews
Reviews lack specific project details, timelines, or costs
data.discrepancy_explanation: Extremely low review volume (5) for a claimed multi-year, established business with a 4.8 rating. No presence on other major review platforms (Angi, Houzz, Yelp) is suspicious for a service business.
